decision.explanation: The documents present two distinct, conflicting reports regarding Rudolf Atamalyan's current representation. Document 1 (D1) explicitly states he signed with 'Sunderland A.F.C.' (D1S2, D1S4). Document 2 (D2) explicitly states he signed with 'Neftchi Baku PFC' (D2S2, D2S15). Per the instruction to keep supported alternate referents rather than selecting a single winner, both are included. 'FC Rostov' (C2) is excluded because D1S9 identifies it only as his previous team ('for FC Rostov last season'), not his current representative team.
